/.title: ConfiGuard-Lite — deepfake screening for images and video
/.description: Uncertainty-aware screening of face manipulation in images and video on an ordinary CPU. An academic research project: results are estimates, not legal proof.

/detect.title: Media detector — ConfiGuard-Lite
/detect.description: Upload a face image or video for a calibrated likely-real, likely-manipulated or uncertain estimate, with quality checks and Content Credentials. Files are deleted after analysis.
